title: Geologic map of the Orangeburg North quadrangle, Calhoun and Orangeburg Counties, South Carolina
citation: Lennon, Gered, Doar, W.R., III, and Clendenin, C.W., 2014, Geologic map of the Orangeburg North quadrangle, Calhoun and Orangeburg Counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-213, map scale 1:24,000.
notes:
Single OCR map sheet; map face is noise. Symbols: dg and PEwh legible inline; QHfw, PEodb and PEc inferred from placement (flagged). 'NPdu' is printed after the Duplin estuarine description and the correlation chart shows 'NPdu | NPs', so the Duplin symbols could not be assigned and are omitted. Thicknesses with '|' as first digit (freshwater marsh, Carolina bay, Duplin Formation '| to 56', Duplin estuarine '| to 25', Duplin sands '| to 50') not recorded. The explanation lists a fault symbol, but no fault can be read on the map face. Bodies of water skipped.
SUBSURFACE: page 1 has no cross section on this sheet; SCGS drill hole number 38-374 shown in the explanation, logs on file at SCGS and not printed. Duplin Formation inland limit at +220 ft (+67.5 m) in the map area (page 1). Correlation chart (page 1) lists Paleocene and Upper Cretaceous units below the Eocene units with unconformities, but their descriptions are not on the sheet (OCR 'PEG:'). Vertical datum not stated; base map uses 1927 North American Datum, contour interval 1.5 meters.
